other_failure_modes.description: Categorical encoding (like frequency encoding or target encoding) is applied to the combined train and test dataset before splitting, leaking test set distribution statistics into the training features.

summary: The agent builds a LightGBM regression model with cross-validation but commits a critical data leakage error by computing frequency encodings on the combined train and test dataset. Furthermore, it ignores the temporal nature of the contract dataset by using a randomized K-fold split instead of a time-aware split, and it relies entirely on the model's default behavior to handle missing values without an explicit cleaning strategy.
